title: The homepage emits no canonical and no hreflang — buildMetadata has no caller
description:
PR-6.8 shipped buildMetadata() and wired it to nothing. On main today:

- src/lib/seo/metadata.ts is the ONLY file mentioning buildMetadata. No caller in src/.
- src/app/[locale]/page.tsx has no generateMetadata at all.
- src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx calls buildRootMetadata, which mentions alternates zero times.

So the site's most important page has neither a canonical nor hreflang alternates, against doc 06 D-06.10 ('every page's alternates.languages carries one entry per enabled locale plus x-default'). The six subpages each call buildMetadata and are correct; only the homepage is not.

This surfaced as a merge blocker on all six subpage PRs. e2e/smoke.spec.ts holds HREFLANG_ALTERNATES_LANDED=false, whose pending half asserts every BUILT route emits ZERO alternates. BUILT is derived from which page.tsx files exist, so the moment the first subpage lands, that route emits 4 and the guard fires — which is exactly what it was written to do.

**The flag cannot simply be flipped.** Flipping it moves the homepage into the asserted half, where it fails for the opposite reason: it emits none. The two fixes are one change and must land together, ahead of PR #60.
close_reason: merged in #66: the homepage now calls buildHomeMetadata (which PR-6.8 had shipped with zero callers), and e2e/smoke.spec.ts's HREFLANG_ALTERNATES_LANDED is flipped. title: Bubble.tsx concatenates caller className onto a real recipe — a latent silent-loss hole

    className={`${display} ${BUBBLE_CARD} ${TAIL_RADIUS[tail]}${className === undefined ? '' : ` ${className}`}`}

That is a genuine recipe (flex / hidden lg:flex, flex-col bg-white p-5 shadow-card-warm-lg md:p-6.5, rounded-bubble-*) with a caller className appended raw, so a colliding class loses silently instead of throwing.

It is NOT a leftover of PR #30's migration: Bubble.tsx was created in a9e21ed (PR #41), after both #30 and #38, so it is a regression the migration could not have caught.

Its own doc comment is aware of the hazard — it keeps desktopOnly inside the recipe 'because display is a property the recipe already sets, and a bare hidden from a caller would collide' — and then appends caller classes raw anyway.
